stories.title: Warm afternoons, dry for Raleigh tree lighting on Friday, parade Saturday
stories.summary: The warmer trend will continue through Friday and Saturday, with highs near 70, which is almost 10 degrees above the historical average!

stories.title: Millbrook, Rolesville meet again in aftermath of fight-marred showdown
stories.summary: Friday night's playoff rematch between Millbrook and Rolesville will have a smaller crowd and increased security after fights disrupted the last game.

stories.title: The herd heads into the Lost World in new 'Ice Age: Boiling Point' trailer
stories.summary: The herd is back in action as the new "Ice Age: Boiling Point" trailer teases a dinosaur-filled trip into the Lost World. See who is joining the voice cast before the film arrives in theaters Feb. 5, 2027.

stories.title: Nearly 10,000 pounds of lead azide to be detonated at Iowa Army plant, causing lead dust plume into Illinois
stories.summary: Two rapid controlled detonations scheduled to take place at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown on Friday have been postponed by three days.

stories.title: Several Durham shootings linked to assaults, robberies, police chief says
stories.summary: Durham's police chief says several shootings this week appear connected as the city reports increases in violent crime and shootings.

stories.title: NC drought reaches 6.2 million people as reservoirs continue to drop: 'Very frustrating'
stories.summary: More than half of North Carolina's population lives in areas affected by drought, according to the state's latest drought report.

stories.title: What to know about Durham's holiday tree lighting event
Hallmark and Walt Disney World teaming up for holiday movie
stories.summary: Hallmark and Walt Disney World are teaming up for the first time ever for an all-new original holiday movie.

stories.title: Second annual Operation Patriot Pantry food drive helps Fort Bragg families
stories.summary: Operation Patriot Pantry's annual food drive collected donations in Fayetteville to help Fort Bragg military families facing food insecurity this holiday season.

stories.title: Actress Yvette Nicole Brown talks 'Disney's Hexed,' caretaking for father with Alzheimer's disease
stories.summary: "Disney's Hexed" is a dazzling movie fantasy, arriving just in time for the holidays.

stories.title: Susan Smith is denied parole again 32 years after drowning her sons in a South Carolina lake
stories.summary: Susan Smith, convicted of killing her two sons by rolling her car into a South Carolina lake in 1994, was denied parole again.

stories.title: After Leesville High student petition, Wake Schools allow tribute ribbons for fallen classmate
stories.summary: Leesville Road High School students who wanted to wear orange ribbons in memory of a classmate during the Raleigh Christmas Parade may be allowed to do so after all.
